paragraphs.text: DSH 的 QQ 群聊插件：人设、记忆、主动搭话、语音、唱歌、表情包、日记
# dsh-qq-group
### 推荐一起装的插件（别人做的，很好用）
| 插件 | 干什么 |

| dsh-see-now | 让她**看得见你的屏幕**——直播式连续画面，不是一张截图 |
[该节后续省略]
### 功能与特点
| 能力 | 说明 |

| **OneBot 11 / NapCat** | 通过 WebSocket 连接 NapCatQQ，支持自动重连、启动检查、自动拉起 |
| **人设与模型** | 多张人设卡；可按群绑定，一张卡

可绑多个群，未绑定跟随全局；模型 provider/model、推理档位、备用模型可按群单独选 |
| **主动搭话** | 独立页：冷场阈值、概率/峰谷命中线、近远时机、冷却、每日上限、安静时段、试

运行、主动语音概率 |
| **价值评分 v3** | 不是每条都回：@/叫名字/引用直接回；普通闲聊按关键词、成员、上下文、熟识度、好感度、夜间等算 0~100 分 |
| **冷场逻辑** | 任

何人类消息都会重置接话去抖和主动开口倒计时；群里一直有人说话时她不插话 |
| **直接对话队列** | 她正在生成时收到的 @/引用会排队，不会丢；主动开口会给 @ 让位 |
| **群友画像**

| 每群每人独立熟识度/好感度；主人数值全局统一且可编辑，不被互动或衰减改动 |
| **群聊开关** | 设置页顶部逐群开关；关闭后完全不接该群消息、不主动开口、不写互动 |
| **日记** |

每条回复记录上下文、评分理由、内心吐槽；thought 放在 JSON 第一项；支持筛选、导出、删除单条/按人删除 |
| **表情包** | 自动收藏、AI 打标签、按语境/关键词选图；自拍图已并入

常用库，用“尾巴/自拍”标签即可被明确请求选中 |
| **语音 / 唱歌** | Edge / CosyVoice2 / Kokoro / GPT-SoVITS 多后端切换；GPT-SoVITS 已

接 v2ProPlus 与 7 种情绪参考音，RVC 变声、语气预设、试听、按群概率 |
| **七情绪** | 开心 / 生气 / 吃惊 / 中立 / 难过 / 厌恶 / 恐惧；按回复文字自动选参考

音，也可手动指定 style |
| **视觉看图** | 可看当前/引用图片，也支持转发聊天记录里的图片；嵌套转发最多展开两层；本地路径与文件头识别 |
| **回复引用** | 目标消息被后续消息

隔开时自动带 QQ 引用，可开关；文件/合并转发/语音不引用，失败自动改发纯文字 |
[该节后续省略]
### 部署要求

- **DeepSeek Harness** 桌面版或可加载插件的主机
- **Node.js 22.12+**、**pnpm 9+**
- **NapCatQQ** + **QQ NT**（Wind

ows 推荐；Linux 可用 NapCat Docker，需自行确认 QQ 登录）
- 一个 QQ 小号作为机器人，已加入目标群
- 可选：视觉模型（识图）、edge-tts（语音，联网）、ffmp

ux 可用 NapCat Docker，需自行确认 QQ 登录）
- 一个 QQ 小号作为机器人，已加入目标群
- 可选：视觉模型（识图）、edge-tts（语音，联网）、ffmpeg（部分音频转换）
### 数据与隐私
| 路径 | 内容 |

| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-qq-group/qq.json` | 连接、群策略、语音/唱歌 |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-qq-group/settings.json` | 人设、模型

、名单、夜间、看图 |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-qq-group/qq-memory.json` | 每群记忆（上限 200 条/群） |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-qq-group

/profiles.json` | 每群每人画像 |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-qq-group/diary.json` | 日记（上限 1000 条） |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-
qq-group/stickers/` | 本地表情包 |
仓库**不包含**任何聊天记忆、日记、QQ 号、token、Cookie 或用户路径；这些只存在于本机运行时。`.gitignore` 已排除数据文件。
### Features
| Feature | Details |
| **OneBot 11 / NapCat** | WebSocket connection to NapCatQQ; reconnect, startup checks, optional aut

o-launch |
| **Persona & model** | Multiple persona cards; bind per group (one card can serve many g

roups), otherwise follow global; provider/model, reasoning effort and fallback can be per group |
|
**Proactive chat** | Dedicated tab: idle threshold, peak/off-peak hit lines, timing factors, cooldow

n, daily cap, quiet hours, trial mode, proactive voice chance |
| **Value scoring v3** | Not a reply
to everything: @/name/quote always reply; ambient chat is scored 0–100 from keywords, members, cont

ext, familiarity, affinity and night penalty |
| **Cold-start logic** | Any human message resets bot

h the reply debounce and proactive countdown; she stays quiet while the group is active |
| **Direct
-message queue** | @/quote messages received while generating are queued, never dropped; proactive m

essages yield to direct ones |
| **Member profiles** | Per-group, per-user familiarity 0–100 and aff

inity -100–+100, updated by speech, mentions, replies, continuity and hostility |
| **Diary** | Ever
y reply records context, score reasons and inner thought; `thought` is the first JSON field; filter,

export, delete one/person |
| **Stickers** | Auto-collect group images, AI rename/tag, context-awar

e sending; count and disk caps |
| **Voice / singing** | Edge / CosyVoice2 / Kokoro / GPT-SoVITS bac
kends, RVC conversion, tone presets, preview, per-group probability; offline singing and built-in sc

ores |
| **Vision** | Optionally pass real QQ images to a vision model: @ / strong context / opinion

questions; local paths and magic-byte detection supported |
| **Reply quoting** | Auto-quote when t
he target is separated by newer messages; toggleable; files/forwards/voice are skipped and failed qu

otes retry as plain text |
| **Token saving** | Adaptive context (fewer turns for self-contained mes
sages, full context for references), contextTurns, memory injection count, mood/hostility toggles |

| **Night DND** | Cross-midnight window; configurable score penalty (0–100, default 20) |
[该节后续省略]
### Requirements

- **DeepSeek Harness** desktop or a host that can load plugins
- **Node.js 22.12+**, **pnpm 9+**
- *
*NapCatQQ** + **QQ NT** (Windows recommended; NapCat Docker on Linux is possible, confirm QQ login y

ourself)
- A spare QQ account for the bot, already in the target group
- Optional: a vision model, e
dge-tts (network), ffmpeg for some audio conversions
### Data and privacy
| Path | Contents |

| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-qq-group/qq.json` | Connection, group policy, voice/singing |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-qq-g

roup/settings.json` | Persona, model, lists, night, vision |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-qq-group/qq-memory.jso

n` | Per-group memory (200 turns/group) |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-qq-group/profiles.json` | Per-group membe

r profiles |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-qq-group/diary.json` | Diary (1000 entries) |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-qq-grou
p/stickers/` | Local stickers |
The repository contains **no** chat memory, diary, QQ numbers, tokens, cookies or user paths; those
exist only in the local runtime. `.gitignore` excludes data files.
